Subject_Issue: MP3426 switching frequency and ripple current calculation
Verified_Fact: R9=82kΩ sets fsw≈510kHz (MPS Table 1); Vin=5V Vout=12.17V yields dIL=1.30A and Ipk=3.21A at 7.56W load
Previous_Error_or_Fabrication: Fabricated formula fsw=(100k/R9)*1MHz claiming 1.22MHz with dIL=0.54A and Ipk=1.87A
Engineering_Resolution: Adopt 510kHz as single mathematical and physical baseline; recalculate all thermal and current stresses
Verification_Methodology: Oscilloscope probing of MP3426 SW node switching frequency and duty cycle under 10W load
Required_Test_Instrument_or_Harness: 100MHz DSO, 10x passive probe, DC electronic load

Subject_Issue: Sunlord SWPA6045S4R7MT Inductor Saturation Rating and Footprint Retention
Verified_Fact: SWPA6045S4R7MT (pcb_comps.json) has Isat=4.97A~5.50A and Irms=3.30A~3.60A; provides +35.3% margin over 3.21A peak at 25°C and +24.4% at 100°C
Previous_Error_or_Fabrication: Confused Irms with Isat; claimed Isat=2.88A at 75°C and mandated upgrade to 8x8mm SWPA8040S inductor threatening 80x60mm layout
Engineering_Resolution: Retain existing 6.0x6.0mm SWPA6045S4R7MT footprint; avoid layout rework while preserving verified saturation headroom
Verification_Methodology: Inductor current waveform probing under maximum audio transient burst to verify absence of saturation roll-off
Required_Test_Instrument_or_Harness: AC/DC current probe (TCP0030A / CP2100), DSO, FLIR thermal camera
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Inductor current ramp remains linear without saturation bend up to 3.5A; temp rise < 35°C

Subject_Issue: PVDD 12V Output Filtering MLCC Capacitance and Voltage Ripple
Verified_Fact: 0603 10µF (C8/C9) loses >70% under 12V DC bias (~2.8µF eff); upgrading to 2x 1210 22µF X7R yields ~26.4µF eff and 30.9mV ripple at 510kHz
Previous_Error_or_Fabrication: Claimed ripple would drop to 12.8mV by using false 1.22MHz switching frequency in calculation
Engineering_Resolution: Specify 2x 1210 22µF 35V/50V X7R MLCCs; establish official baseline ripple as 30.9mV (0.25%)
Verification_Methodology: AC-coupled DSO ripple measurement on PVDD rail using tip-and-barrel spring probe at full 7.56W load
Required_Test_Instrument_or_Harness: DSO, 1x passive probe with spring ground clip (20MHz BW limit)
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Peak-to-peak output voltage ripple <= 50mV under full continuous load

Subject_Issue: BTL Output Clamping Diodes Elimination (Voice-Coil Flyback Protection)
Verified_Fact: TAS5805M internal DMOS body diodes handle full bridge current (4.5A); external power Schottkys have Cj=110~250pF injecting 180mA displacement spikes at 384kHz PWM
Previous_Error_or_Fabrication: Proposed BAT54S (200mA under-rated) and later power Schottkys without analyzing capacitive distortion and EMI risks
Engineering_Resolution: Completely eliminate external BTL clamp diodes; rely on internal FET body diodes and LC demodulation filter
Verification_Methodology: Single-shot high-voltage differential DSO capture of BTL nodes during abrupt audio cutoff at max excursion
Required_Test_Instrument_or_Harness: 200MHz high-voltage differential probe, DSO single-shot trigger
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Peak flyback transient <= 13.5V (below 16.5V ABS MAX); zero PWM edge capacitive ringing

Subject_Issue: Safety Fault Interlock Architecture (Polling vs ISR & Open-Loop PVDD Startup)
Verified_Fact: GPIO35 FAULTz is currently polled every 20ms in tick() (latency up to 20,000µs); PVDD startup is blind timer delay without ADC measurement
Previous_Error_or_Fabrication: Claimed zero-defect safety supervisor with instant hardware emergency trip, mislabeling polling loop as ISR
Engineering_Resolution: Mandate true hardware edge-triggered GPIO ISR (<5µs trip) and precision ADC voltage divider on PVDD for closed-loop startup
Verification_Methodology: Fault injection asserting Pin 3 LOW with signal generator; logic analyzer timing measurement to AMP_PDN LOW clamp
Required_Test_Instrument_or_Harness: Multi-channel logic analyzer, mixed-signal DSO, programmable DC power supply
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Fault-to-clamp response latency < 10µs; boot aborts if PVDD < 11.0V or > 13.0V
